svg.text: Before / after — how the Design Studio differs
Left: today's /creative-studio. Right: the proposed Design Studio. Same paper-and-pine identity; the difference is what sits in the middle.
no canvas · no layers · no format presets · every preview is a placeholder
results written to the master brain

text.font-family: Libre Baskerville, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: northstar-os-ui/src/studio/** already renders documents, formats, mockups and 3D packaging on a dependency-free Canvas 2D path. It is uncommitted and imported by nothing.
One content-type selector replaces eight flat tabs
Formats, templates, compliance rules and brief fields are all derived from the selected content type, so a listing image and a Sponsored Brands banner can no longer drift apart.
Compliance moves from absent to pre-flight
Amazon image and ad rules become a blocking check inside the compose flow, alongside a claims guardrail that refuses unsupported claims at compose time.
Creatives become bound to search terms
Each asset carries the term it targets and the ad data behind it, which is what makes the learning loop possible at all.
Product composites stay the operator's own photography, reference-locked across panels. Blocked, unknown and provider-required states stay visible, exactly as they are today.

Render 09 — the comparison. Left column reconstructed from the shipped CreativeStudio.jsx; right column is the proposed Design Studio. No competitor design is copied or embedded; every pattern here is the repo's own.
